description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Tri-Element Mode III (Fire, Ice, Lightning) v2], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Double Bluff Mode] to the user

description.name: Tri-Element Mode III (Fire, Ice, Lightning) v2
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking] after using a Fire/Ice/Lightning ability

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Double Bluff Mode
description.text: Grants [Black Magic +50% Boost 1] and Twincast +1 to the user after using two of Ice Crush or A Little Black Magic, grants [Buff Fire 10% (15s)], [Buff Ice 10% (15s)] and [Buff Lightning 10% (15s)] to the user after using two of Ice Crush or A Little Black Magic if Porom is alive
